prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System: advisory-only; command authority preserved; impaired operation prioritizes command-continuity. Actors: local fire agencies/county emergency management/state wildland fire resources/aviation support units/cooperating public safety partners. North Lookout Camera Mast→Thermal Spot Snippet/bearings; South Lookout Camera Mast→triangulation/Camera Cleaning Log; both→health telemetry. Smoke Classifier Module→smoke/growth/confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask; degraded imagery advisory, contamination checks, insufficient for aviation. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine(Lantern)→traceable detections/perimeters/recommendations/hazards/probability-bands; degradation downweighted; exposure-refresh requires valid reconnaissance/weather-timing; repository-outage retains approved configuration/rejects unsigned/unversioned analytics. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node(Brindle)→terrain-weather/Wind Shift Bulletin/exposure-flags/cached weather. Caldera Incident Command Portal(Emberhall)→triage/approval/assignments; perimeter/priority review mandatory. Duty Detection Officer(Orion) verifies, receives stale/partial-coverage warnings. Confirmation requires persistent smoke/thermal plus independent corroboration/authorized judgment; dismissals searchable; Confirmed Ignition State≠dispatch. Disconnected operating mode: timestamped cached-review/queued-updates; irreversible releases blocked. Crewline Mobile Tablet: encrypted queues; reconciliation preserves author/device-time/server-acceptance-time. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock(Kestrel)→readiness/health/recovery; maintenance controller→Battery Swap Ticket. Drone Tasking Service→missions/windows/images/altitudes/abort-criteria/status; degraded-communications automated-release requires corridor-permit validation. Drone Pilot Operator checks endurance/routes/return/separation; readiness≠assignment. Imagery requires weather/airspace/communications clearance/orthorectification/grid-registration. Air Attack Supervisor(Redtail) authorizes aviation; Airspace Restricted State requires accepted routes/altitudes/helitack-boundary confirmation. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console(Marigold) blocks unapproved/unready release→Runway Release Note/Suppression Drop Receipt. Tanker Base Manager reconciles East Retardant Loading Pump→Retardant Batch Slip; East/West Retardant Loading Pump→state/flow/outages; loading≠approval. Records: agency-policy incident retention; raw sensors shorter approved schedule; encryption-at-rest/controlled-export/documented-authorized-deletion. Multi-period incidents

New part:
S211: All operational users shall receive communications training that includes VHF Radio Gateway Repeater failure modes, alternate contact paths, call signs, message brevity, and confirmation readbacks.
S212: Weather training shall explain how the MesoWest Weather Fusion Node supports situational awareness and how operators should treat weather inputs when local observations conflict with displayed values.
S213: Initial qualification shall include supervised console practice, scenario walkthroughs, and a documented check by an instructor who is authorized by the operations lead.
S214: Annual refresher training shall include changes to software screens, revised thresholds, updated contact rosters, seasonal hazard briefings, and lessons learned from prior incidents.
S215: Tabletop exercises shall be conducted before the expected peak fire period and shall test detection triage, command notification, airspace coordination, tanker-base coordination, crew deployment, and public-agency liaison actions.
S216: Live exercises shall be scheduled at least once per season when conditions permit and shall include field crews, aircraft coordination staff, drone operations staff, and command-center personnel.
S217: Exercise controllers shall inject realistic complications such as intermittent network service, obscured camera views, delayed field confirmation, resource conflicts, and conflicting reports from external observers.
S218: Performance measures shall include time from automated detection to human review, time from review to command notification, time to resource assignment, communication completion rate, and accuracy of incident status updates.
S219: Detection quality shall be evaluated using confirmed events, benign smoke sources, weather-related artifacts, and operator notes so that both missed detections and false alarms are visible to program management.
S220: Every false-alarm review shall identify the apparent cause, affected sensors or analytic outputs, operator actions, dispatch consequences, and any recommended tuning or training change.
S221: The review board shall include operations, aviation, field crew, maintenance, and county liaison representatives when the event affected more than one operational function.
S222: Seasonal readiness shall require each active user to demonstrate current proficiency, complete required safety briefings, and acknowledge the current operating procedures before receiving operational access.
S223: Personnel who do not meet proficiency requirements shall complete remedial training and a repeat evaluation before performing unsupervised duties in the Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System.
S224: Deployment governance for the Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System shall be managed as a staged release process that follows completion of seasonal readiness activities.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
